title: NCLEX-PN
issuer: National Council of State Boards of Nursing
content_provenance: Original practice items authored from the public NCLEX-PN test plan. Not a capture of past exam questions.

items.stem: A client needs to have a task delegated. Which action is most appropriate for the practical nurse? Which action is most appropriate?
options: Call the provider immediately
Elevate the affected extremity as ordered
Maintain the current regimen as prescribed
Provide reassurance and continue monitoring
items.explanation: The correct action prioritizes client safety based on the immediate needs described in this scenario. Other options may be appropriate later but are not the priority at this time.
items.reference: NCLEX-PN Test Plan - Safe and Effective Care Environment
